newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mostly lower.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were mostly lower Friday in line with losses on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange, dealers said.
"We're down a little bit, just with the board," said a Montana dealer. "It was pretty quiet here today."
Wheat futures on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange settled 3-1/4 to 6-1/2 cents per bushel lower, with July down 3-1/4 at $3.98-1/4 on weather.
Dryness has been a concern for farmers in the Dakotas, but private forecasts showed rain headed for those states early next week.
A Washington grain dealer said that farmer selling interest was muted and would stay that way until harvest begins, he said.
